ideas.title: Heart Attack Prediction
ideas.subtitle: AI-powered health risk prediction with web-based interaction
ideas.description: A machine learning powered web app that predicts heart attack risk from patient health data. Provides clear risk assessment, preventive care guidance, and lifestyle recommendations based on the prediction results.
coreCapabilities: Web interface for entering patient health data
ML model predicts heart attack risk level
intelligenceLayer: Shows preventive care and lifestyle guidance
ideas.systemFlow: User Input → React Web App → Flask / FastAPI (ML Backend) → Risk Prediction → Firebase (store user & result data) → Result & Guidance Display
